lead: I work hands on with large-scale systems, thinking big and innovating along the way. Often curious about everything. Currently SDE I at Amazon.
body: I came to software through the problem-solving side of it in college, and stayed for the part where you learn to build what you can imagine. Most of my day job is full-stack work on various different services, mainly Java throughout.
Away from the keyboard: lifting, guitar, and an ongoing battle to cook something that does not taste like chicken and rice. Oh yeah and probably learning something new.
